assumptions: Harbor does not report cache writes; trial cache writes are priced at the input rate.
Infrastructure failures are not discounted from spend.
Each trial resamples measured per-trial costs of its task; tasks never seen draw from tasks of the same difficulty, then from the whole cell.

Figures from fewer than 3 trials, from another model or from a prior carry an extra spread set by stats.prior_sd_log, once per arm (the level is uncertain); a trial drawn from fewer than 3 measured values gets the same spread on its own.
Pairs after the run assume the new trials succeed and run the same task versions as earlier ones; trials pair by the report's rule (report.match_on, report.same_run_only).
Wall time: 1 minute of preflight per arm, trials longest first on n_concurrent slots, arms in design order on parallel_arms slots.

Trial minutes count the harness setup each arm's plan expects (a stock install, or a pre-baked image when every trial should get one) in place of the setup each measured trial had: the ledger's median for that setup, else a prior for pre-baked images.
Reused tasks are not run and cost nothing here; the cost avoided is each reused task's mean measured trial cost x attempts, and its trials count as pairs already in hand.
